title: Write-only encrypted credential in DuckgresServer admin: exclude model field, use new_* form field
answers: How do I let staff set a secret in the Duckgres server Django admin without showing it?
Blank password in admin form erased stored value
How is the Trino password set in admin?
body:
Secret fields on DuckgresServer are write-only in admin. Pattern in products/managed_warehouse/backend/admin/duckgres_server_admin.py:
- `DuckgresServerAdminForm.Meta.exclude` drops the real model field (`trino_password`).
- A separate `new_trino_password` CharField uses `PasswordInput(render_value=False)`, `required=False`, `strip=False`.
- `DuckgresServerAdminForm.save` only assigns the model field when the submitted value is non-empty, so a blank submit preserves the stored value.
- `DuckgresServerAdmin.trino_password_configured` (a boolean `admin.display`, listed in `readonly_fields`) shows status only.
Both `fieldsets` and `add_fieldsets` must list `new_trino_password`; the existing `password` and `trino_password` must not appear in the change form (asserted in tests/test_admin.py).
applies: DuckgresServer admin and any new encrypted credential field on it
